use_case_summary: SparrowGate will host high-volume chat and reranking models inside their VPC. Primary requirement: no plaintext customer PII leaves their environment. Low-latency (<50ms tail for chat) on dedicated GPU pools for peak windows. Auditability for every inference call (token-level metadata) and 7+ year retention for logs tied to regulatory needs.
requirements_summary: In-transit: mTLS between Redwood inference runtime and customer edge; mutual certs; cert rotation automation or documented manual rotation steps
At-rest: encrypted volumes with customer-managed keys (BYOK) via KMS — must support AWS KMS + external HSM connector
Key rotation: policy to rotate envelope keys quarterly, automated key rotation workflow, and a documented emergency key-revoke procedure
Secrets mgmt: integrate with HashiCorp Vault or Secrets Manager; support short-lived tokens and least-privilege IAM roles
Audit logging: immutable logs exported to customer SIEM (Splunk/Datadog) and ability to sign logs (log sealing) for forensic use
Data residency: compute must run in US-only regions; optional EU tenancy for EU-regulated business lines
Operational: must provide playbook for incident response with timeline and contact escalation (24/7 P1 SLA)
Compliance artifacts: SOC2 + ISO27001 copies, penetration test summary, KMS/HSM attestation docs
